slides.title: HOW TO ENDURE TO THE END
slides.sub: He that shall endure unto the end, the same shall be saved.
slides.notes: Opening. Introduce Matthew 24:12–13. The tech team controls scripture screens.

slides.title: Matthew 24:12–13
slides.text:
12. And because iniquity shall abound, the love of many shall wax cold.
13. But he that shall endure unto the end, the same shall be saved.

points: Many will fall away, but many will also endure. God desires that we finish the race.
slides.notes: Teach the main point. Scripture passages follow in order.

slides.title: Romans 13:11–12
slides.text:
11. And that, knowing the time, that now it is high time to awake out of sleep: for now is our salvation nearer than when we believed.

slides.title: Matthew 25:1–3
slides.text:
1. Then shall the kingdom of heaven be likened unto ten virgins, which took their lamps, and went forth to meet the bridegroom.
2. And five of them were wise, and five were foolish.
3. They that were foolish took their lamps, and took no oil with them:
slides.notes: Scripture: Matthew 25:1–3. Coordinate reading with the tech team.

slides.title: Matthew 25:4–6
slides.text:
4. But the wise took oil in their vessels with their lamps.
5. While the bridegroom tarried, they all slumbered and slept.
6. And at midnight there was a cry made, Behold, the bridegroom cometh; go ye out to meet him.
slides.notes: Scripture: Matthew 25:4–6. Coordinate reading with the tech team.

slides.title: Matthew 25:7–9
slides.text:
7. Then all those virgins arose, and trimmed their lamps.
8. And the foolish said unto the wise, Give us of your oil; for our lamps are gone out.
9. But the wise answered, saying, Not so; lest there be not enough for us and you: but go ye rather to them that sell, and buy for yourselves.
slides.notes: Scripture: Matthew 25:7–9. Coordinate reading with the tech team.

slides.title: Matthew 25:10–12
slides.text:
10. And while they went to buy, the bridegroom came; and they that were ready went in with him to the marriage: and the door was shut.
11. Afterward came also the other virgins, saying, Lord, Lord, open to us.
12. But he answered and said, Verily I say unto you, I know you not.
slides.notes: Scripture: Matthew 25:10–12. Coordinate reading with the tech team.

slides.title: Matthew 25:13
slides.text: Watch therefore, for ye know neither the day nor the hour wherein the Son of man cometh.
slides.notes: Scripture: Matthew 25:13. Coordinate reading with the tech team.

slides.title: Live Faithfully: Endure as a Good Soldier
points: Remain committed to Christ through hardship, determined to finish the race.
slides.notes: Teach the main point. Scripture passages follow in order.

slides.title: 2 Timothy 2:3–4
slides.text:
3. Thou therefore endure hardness, as a good soldier of Jesus Christ.
4. No man that warreth entangleth himself with the affairs of this life; that he may please him who hath chosen him to be a soldier.
slides.notes: Scripture: 2 Timothy 2:3–4. Coordinate reading with the tech team.

slides.title: 2 Timothy 4:7–8
slides.text:
7. I have fought a good fight, I have finished my course, I have kept the faith:
8. Henceforth there is laid up for me a crown of righteousness, which the Lord, the righteous judge, shall give me at that day: and not to me only, but unto all them also that love his appearing.
slides.notes: Scripture: 2 Timothy 4:7–8. Coordinate reading with the tech team.

slides.title: I Want to Finish
points: Endurance comes from keeping our eyes on Jesus, the author and finisher of our faith.
slides.notes: Teach the main point. Scripture passages follow in order.

slides.title: Hebrews 12:1
slides.text: Wherefore seeing we also are compassed about with so great a cloud of witnesses, let us lay aside every weight, and the sin which doth so easily beset us, and let us run with patience the race that is set before us,
slides.notes: Scripture: Hebrews 12:1. Coordinate reading with the tech team.

slides.title: Hebrews 12:2–3
slides.text:
2. Looking unto Jesus the author and finisher of our faith; who for the joy that was set before him endured the cross, despising the shame, and is set down at the right hand of the throne of God.
3. For consider him that endured such contradiction of sinners against himself, lest ye be wearied and faint in your minds.
slides.notes: Scripture: Hebrews 12:2–3. Coordinate reading with the tech team.

slides.title: 2 Timothy 4:7
slides.text: I have fought a good fight, I have finished my course, I have kept the faith:
slides.notes: Scripture: 2 Timothy 4:7. Coordinate reading with the tech team.

slides.title: I don't just want to start with Jesus. I want to finish with Jesus.
slides.notes: Closing declaration. Pause after the statement.

slides.text: But he that shall endure unto the end, the same shall be saved.
